√naś1 'be lost'
present: [4.] náśyati etc. V.+ náśyate etc. -- [1.] náśati náśate etc. 
perfect: nanāśa neśus B.+ 
aorist: [2.] anaśat E.+ -- [3.] aneśat etc. anīnaśat etc. V.+ nīnaśus 
future: [1.] naśiṣyati AV.+ naṅkṣyati naṅkṣyate etc. E.+ anaṅkṣyata -- [2.] naśitā naṅṣṭā 
verbal: naṣṭá V.+ naṣṭum naṅṣṭum naṣṭvā naṅṣṭvā 
secondary: intensive: nānaś- -- desiderative: ninaśiṣa- ninaṅkṣa- -- causative: nāśáyati etc. V.+ nāśáyate etc. E.+ nāśayádhyai nināśayiṣa- 
derivatives: -naś -naṅśin V.S. naśana B.+ naṅśuka K. naṣṭi B.+ naśvara C. nāśa B.+ nāśaka E.+ nāśin B.+ nāśya E.+ nā́śana AV.+ nā́śuka TS. nāṣṭrā́ AV.B. nāśayitṛ́ VS. 
The forms from the stem naśa are perhaps to be classed as of aorist 2.

√naś2 'attain'
present: [1.] náśati náśate etc. 
aorist: [1.] ā́naṭ naṭ anaṣṭām náṅśi naśīmahi 
verbal: -náśe 
secondary: desiderative: ínakṣati etc. 
derivatives: náṅśa -náṅśana RV. -náśa V. -nā́śa RV.S. 
The form ā́naṭ is by some referred to √1aś. Compare √nakṣ.
